label: New visitors
numerator: users with first_visit in the sample, bots removed
caveat: A visitor is a browser cookie, not a person

label: Add to cart rate
numerator: added to cart after viewing, within 7 days

label: Checkout rate
numerator: began checkout after cart, within 7 days

label: Return within 7 days
numerator: any event on days 1–7 after first visit

label: Weekly cohort retention
numerator: cohort visitors active in week k (days 7k..7k+6)
caveat: Cells not fully observed are unknown, not zero

label: Return within a month (after day one)
caveat: Driver outcome; features use the first 24h only

label: Average order value
numerator: sum of purchase revenue over distinct transactions

label: Odds ratio (adjusted)
numerator: odds of returning with the behaviour
denominator: odds without it, other terms held equal

label: Rounds played
caveat: Winsorized at pooled 99.9th percentile; margin −2.5; measured after assignment

label: Spend per customer
caveat: Zero-inflated; percentile bootstrap CI; revenue, not profit
